entities.name: Web3D Consortium
entities.note: A non-profit organization that develops and maintains the X3D, VRML, and H-Anim standards.

entities.name: ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 24
entities.note: The ISO/IEC subcommittee responsible for standardization of computer graphics, image processing, and environmental data representation.

entities.name: W3C
entities.note: The World Wide Web Consortium, which collaborates with Web3D on HTML5 and web integration.

entities.name: Khronos Group
entities.note: An industry consortium creating open standards for 3D graphics, such as glTF, which Web3D integrates into X3D.

entities.name: X3D Working Group
entities.note: The primary working group within the Web3D Consortium responsible for developing the X3D specification.

entities.name: H-Anim Working Group
entities.note: The working group focused on the Humanoid Animation (H-Anim) standard for representing human figures.

entities.name: Medical Working Group
entities.note: A Web3D working group dedicated to the use of X3D in medical imaging and healthcare applications.

entities.name: Heritage Working Group
entities.note: A working group focusing on the preservation and presentation of cultural heritage using X3D.

entities.name: Design Printing and Scanning Working Group
entities.note: A working group standardizing the pipeline from 3D scanning to 3D printing using X3D.

entities.name: VRML97
entities.note: The Virtual Reality Modeling Language standard (ISO/IEC 14772), the predecessor to X3D.

entities.name: X3D
entities.note: The Extensible 3D Graphics standard, an open, royalty-free ISO standard for 3D on the web.

entities.name: X3D 3.0
entities.note: The first major release of the X3D standard, transitioning from VRML97 to an XML-based architecture.

entities.name: X3D 3.3
entities.note: A widely adopted version of X3D that introduced new nodes for volume rendering, CAD, and geospatial data.

entities.name: X3D 4.0
entities.note: A major milestone of X3D deeply integrating with HTML5, glTF, and Web Audio.

entities.name: X3D 4.1
entities.note: An upcoming milestone for X3D focusing on further enhancements and new capabilities.

entities.name: H-Anim
entities.note: The Humanoid Animation standard for representing articulated 3D human figures.

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19775-1
entities.note: The ISO document specifying the X3D Architecture and base components.

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19775-2
entities.note: The ISO document specifying the X3D Scene Access Interface (SAI).

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19776-1
entities.note: The ISO document specifying the X3D XML encoding.

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19776-2
entities.note: The ISO document specifying the X3D ClassicVRML encoding.

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19776-3
entities.note: The ISO document specifying the X3D Compressed binary encoding.

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19777-1
entities.note: The ISO document specifying the X3D ECMAScript binding.

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19777-2
entities.note: The ISO document specifying the X3D Java binding.

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19774-1
entities.note: The ISO document specifying the H-Anim Architecture.

entities.name: ISO/IEC 19774-2
entities.note: The ISO document specifying the H-Anim Motion data animation.

entities.name: XML Encoding
entities.note: The X3D encoding format that uses XML syntax.

entities.name: ClassicVRML Encoding
entities.note: The X3D encoding format that uses the traditional VRML curly-brace syntax.

entities.name: Compressed Binary Encoding
entities.note: The X3D encoding format that uses Fast Infoset and geometric compression for efficient transmission.

entities.name: JSON Encoding
entities.note: An X3D encoding format representing the scene graph using JSON syntax.

entities.name: X3D Unified Object Model
entities.note: An XML-based comprehensive definition of all X3D nodes, fields, and relationships used to generate bindings and encodings.

entities.name: glTF
entities.note: The GL Transmission Format, an open standard for 3D models developed by the Khronos Group.

entities.name: HTML5
entities.note: The fifth major version of HTML, deeply integrated with X3D 4.0 for native web rendering.

entities.name: X3D Validator
entities.note: A suite of tools provided by the Web3D Consortium to check X3D scenes for standard compliance.

triples.s: Design Printing and Scanning Working Group
